---
title: "Dashboard Diabète (Prévalence / Incidence)"
format: dashboard
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

clean_utf8 <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  else x
}

prev <- st_read("output/carte_prevalence.gpkg", layer = "prev", quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), clean_utf8)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 100)

inc <- st_read("output/carte_incidence.gpkg", layer = "inc", quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), clean_utf8)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 100)

annees <- sort(unique(prev$annee))

make_map_prev <- function(annee_val) {
  d <- prev |> filter(annee == annee_val)
  pal <- colorBin("YlGnBu", domain = d$diabete, bins = 6, na.color = "#bdbdbd")
  leaflet(d) |>
    addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas, group = "Fond clair") |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(diabete), fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "white", weight = 1,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>", nom_dep, "</b><br/>Prévalence : ", round(diabete, 1))
    ) |>
    addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~diabete,
              title = paste0("Prévalence ", annee_val), opacity = 0.9) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("CartoDB", "OpenStreetMap", "Satellite"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
}

make_map_inc <- function(annee_val) {
  d <- inc |> filter(annee == annee_val)
  pal <- colorBin("YlOrRd", domain = d$diabete, bins = 6, na.color = "#bdbdbd")
  leaflet(d) |>
    addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas, group = "Fond clair") |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(diabete), fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "white", weight = 1,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>", NOM, "</b><br/>Incidence : ", round(diabete, 1))
    ) |>
    addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~diabete,
              title = paste0("Incidence ", annee_val), opacity = 0.9) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("CartoDB", "OpenStreetMap", "Satellite"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
}
```

# Statistiques

## Row
```{r}
#| title: "Évolution Prévalence"
st_drop_geometry(prev) |>
  group_by(annee) |>
  summarise(Moyenne = mean(diabete, na.rm = TRUE),
            Min = min(diabete, na.rm = TRUE),
            Max = max(diabete, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(annee), y = Moyenne)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Min, ymax = Max), width = 0.2, color = "gray40") +
  labs(title = "Prévalence moyenne par année", x = "Année", y = "Valeur") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
```{r}
#| title: "Évolution Incidence"
st_drop_geometry(inc) |>
  group_by(annee) |>
  summarise(Moyenne = mean(diabete, na.rm = TRUE),
            Min = min(diabete, na.rm = TRUE),
            Max = max(diabete, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(annee), y = Moyenne)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Min, ymax = Max), width = 0.2, color = "gray40") +
  labs(title = "Incidence moyenne par année", x = "Année", y = "Valeur") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Row
```{r}
#| title: "Top 10 — Prévalence 2024"
st_drop_geometry(prev) |>
  filter(annee == 2024) |>
  arrange(desc(diabete)) |> slice(1:10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(nom_dep, diabete), y = diabete)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 départements — Prévalence 2024", x = "", y = "Valeur") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
